title: Music in the Wind
summary: A lyrical exploration of wind, sound, and invisible forces. Final blends and FLOSS words create a musical rhythm that mirrors the wind's movement.

pages.text: The wind falls soft and still.
pages.scene: Gentle breeze through tall grass, barely visible movement
Grass and flowers bowing gracefully in the wind

pages.text: The bell will hum and ring.
pages.scene: A brass bell swinging, creating ripples of sound
Bell vibrating, notes hanging in the air like visible sound waves

pages.text: The wind is swift and blind.
pages.scene: Wind tossing leaves and dust, shape-shifting, invisible
Wind rushing through trees, whispering and soothing
Sunset colors mingling in clouds, soft and warm

pages.text: The wind will blow and huff.
pages.scene: Wind bringing the day to an end, all colors fading to dusk

metadata.aesthetic_focus: Invisible forces, sound and sensation, wind as character
